title: A eudicot stem in cross-section
caption: In a eudicot stem the vascular bundles form a ring between the cortex and the pith. In each bundle the xylem is on the inner side and the phloem on the outer side. (In a monocot the bundles are scattered.)
alt: A circular stem section: an epidermis, a cortex, a ring of eight vascular bundles each with a larger xylem circle on the inner side and a smaller phloem circle on the outer side, and a pith in the middle.
description: Layers from the outside in: epidermis, cortex, a ring of vascular bundles, pith.
In each bundle xylem is on the inner side and phloem on the outer side.
In a monocot stem the vascular bundles are scattered instead of in a ring.
